title: REQ · listExecutions calls GET /api/v1/admin/executions with the admin token
summary: listExecutions returns the ExecutionInfo array from the admin endpoint
description: Context: backend execution.Handler.List responds 200 with a JSON array of executions ([] when empty). Desired behavior: client.ts exports listExecutions(token) built on adminRequest. Expected result: callers receive ExecutionInfo[] or an ApiError on non-2xx. Why: admin console needs the list.
acceptance_criteria: Given token T, when listExecutions(T) is called, then fetch receives /api/v1/admin/executions with header Authorization: Bearer T and no POST method
Given a 401 response, when listExecutions is called, then it rejects with an ApiError whose status is 401
technical_constraints: No world query param: the list handler takes none
